name: שברים חלקיים – בחירת הצורה המתאימה עם גורם ריבועי אי-פריק (באנגלית)
questiontext:
Select the appropriate format for expressing the following rational function in partial fractions. \[ f(x) = {{CT:0}} \] \[ (1) = \frac{A}{x-{{CT:1}}} + \frac{B}{x-{{CT:1}}} + \frac{C}{{CT:2}},\quad (2) = \frac{A}{(x-{{CT:1}})^2} + \frac{B}{x-{{CT:1}}} + \frac{C x + D}{{CT:2}}, \] \[ (3) = \frac{A}{(x-{{CT:1}})^2} + \frac{B}{x-{{CT:1}}} + \frac{C}{{CT:2}},\quad (4) = \frac{A}{x-{{CT:1}}} + \frac{B}{x-{{CT:1}}} + \frac{C x + D}{{CT:2}}. \] Format [[input:af]] [[validation:af]]
Calculate the unknown coefficients. Enter these in the correct order as a list, i.e. \([A,B,C,D]\) below, inserting a zero for any unused coefficients. [[input:ans1]] [[validation:ans1]]
generalfeedback: \[ f(x) = {{CT:0}} \] To express as partial fractions let\[ {{CT:0}}= \frac{A}{{CT:3}}+\frac{B}{{CT:4}}+\frac{Cx+D}{{CT:2}}, \mbox{ which is format 2.}\] Multiplying throughout by {{CT:5}} gives \[{{CT:6}}=A({{CT:2}})+B({{CT:4}})({{CT:2}})+(Cx+D){{CT:3}}\] Let \(x = {{CT:1}}\), therefore \[{{CT:7}}={{CT:8}}\] \[A=\frac{{CT:7}}{{CT:9}}={{CT:10}}\] Let \(x = 0\), therefore \[{{CT:11}}=A({{CT:12}})+B({{CT:13}})({{CT:12}})+D({{CT:14}})={{CT:15}}\] \[{{CT:16}} ={{CT:17}}\] Equate coefficients of \(x^3\) \[{{CT:18}} = B+C\] Equate coefficients of \(x^2\) \[{{CT:19}} = {{CT:20}}={{CT:21}}\] \[{{CT:22}} = {{CT:23}}\] Solving the 4 equations in \(A,B,C\) and \(D\) gives \[{{CT:24}}\]

on_false.feedback: You have the wrong form, so I can't consider your answer to the second part.
